### Utila Island

A ferry ride of just one hour brings you to Utila Island. Its youthful atmosphere is immediately apparent. Of all the Bay Islands, Utila is closest to the mainland and offers the most affordable prices, attracting young travelers from around the world.

## Holidays on the Island

### Utila: A Paradise for Young Travelers

Honduras shares part of the Belize Barrier Reef, the world's second-largest barrier reef system. The island is described as the world's least expensive place to earn a diving certification from the respected PADI association, and its underwater world is beautiful and diverse. There are many bars, cafés, and internet cafés on the island.

Uxmal is one of the major Maya archaeological complexes on the Yucatán Peninsula. Its stone architecture belongs to the Puuc tradition. Notable structures include the Pyramid of the Magician, the Governor's Palace, and the House of the Turtles. The facades and arrangement of buildings help visitors imagine the layout of the ancient city.

Local legends associated with Uxmal enrich a visit to its buildings. The complex is often visited together with Kabah, allowing travelers to compare the expansive squares and decorative techniques of neighboring Maya centers. Both the imposing buildings as a whole and the surviving stone details on individual facades are worth exploring.
